ICS 77.140.50                          MTD 04Reaffirmed 20221. ScopeThis standard covers the requirements for hot rolled low carbon steel sheets, plates and strips intended for drawing and forming for automobile and general engineering purposes.2. ReferencedThe following standards contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate thepossibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:228 (In various parts) Method for chemical analysis of steel1599 : 2012 Metallic materials - Bend test (third revision)1608 : 2005 Metallic materials - Tensile testing at ambient temperature (third revision)1730 : 1989 Dimensions for steel plates, sheets, strips and flats for general engineering purposes (second revision)1852 : 1985 Rolling and cutting tolerances for hot rolled steel products (fourth revision)1956 (Part 4) : 2013 Glossary of terms relating to iron and steel: Part 4 Flat products (second revision)3803 (Part 1) : 1989 Steel - Conversion of elongation values: Part 1 Carbon and low alloy steels8910 : 2010 General technical delivery requirements for steel and steel products10175 : 2012 Metallic materials - Sheet and strip - Erichsen cupping test (second revision )IS/ISO 16160 : 2005 Continuously hot-rolled steel sheet products - Dimensional and shape tolerances
